Package index

Package overview

Top-level documentation entry.

chamaeleon chamaeleon-package
chamaeleon: Multiscale analysis of chameleon behaviour in stochastic strange attractors

Phase-space reconstruction

Takens delay embedding and the Cao false-nearest-neighbours dimension estimator.

takens_embed()
Takens time-delay embedding
estimate_embedding_params()
Estimate embedding parameters

Scale decomposition (MEMD)

Multivariate empirical mode decomposition (Rehman & Mandic 2010) and partial-sum reconstruction.

memd()
Multivariate empirical mode decomposition
memd_partial_sums()
Compute partial sums of MIMFs for scale-dependent analysis

Extreme-value metrics

Local dimension and extremal index from peaks-over-threshold of the recurrence statistic.

evt_metrics()
Compute EVT-based instantaneous dynamical metrics
scale_dependent_metrics()
Compute scale-dependent EVT metrics

Chameleon analysis and testing

End-to-end pipeline plus surrogate-based hypothesis tests.

chameleon_analysis()
Complete chameleon attractor analysis
chameleon_test()
Statistical test for chameleon attractor behavior
chameleon_test_nonstationary()
Test for non-stationary chameleon behavior
plot(<chameleon_surrogates>) generate_surrogates()
Plot method for chameleon_surrogates objects

Visualization

Dedicated 3D trajectory renderer (plotly).

plot_trajectory_3d()
Plot 3D attractor trajectory as line
